intro: Bilibili (哔哩哔哩, B站) is where much of China's gaming, anime, tech and youth culture lives, but its interface is Chinese-only and its web API needs request signing and passes anti-bot checks. This actor handles that for you and needs **no login, no cookies and nothing to configure**.

Give it keywords in Chinese or English, specific video URLs, BV ids or av ids, or switch on the popular feed (热门). Each video row includes views, likes, coins (投币), favorites, shares, danmaku (弹幕) count and comment count, plus tags, category, duration, publish time, cover image, the uploader's channel and their follower count. Optionally, `includeComments` attaches a sample of top and newest comments, anonymised to text, time and likes.

It is used for China influencer and KOL discovery, brand and campaign monitoring, competitor content research and gaming or anime trend analysis. Videos cost $4 per 1,000 and anonymised comments $0.50 per 1,000. Text comes back in its original language, mostly Simplified Chinese, and is not translated.
howItWorks: Keyword searches run against Bilibili's own search with your chosen `sortBy` order, up to `maxVideos` per term (Bilibili caps search at 1,000 results per term).
Each search hit is enriched with a per-video detail lookup to add coins, shares, tags and the uploader's follower count.
Video URLs, BV ids and av ids in `videoUrls` are fetched directly; deleted, private or region-locked videos are skipped and never charged.
With `includePopular` on, the current popular feed is added, again up to `maxVideos`.
With `includeComments` on, about 60 top and newest comments per video (including replies) are attached, with commenter names, IDs and avatars removed.

faq.q: Can I scrape Bilibili without logging in?
faq.a: Yes. The actor uses only public data any visitor can see: videos, stats and channel info. It needs no account, no cookies and no configuration.

faq.q: How many Bilibili search results can I get per keyword?
faq.a: Up to 1,000 per term, which is Bilibili's own cap (50 pages of 20). Set `maxVideos` to control how many you take; it ranges from 1 to 1,000.

faq.q: Does it return all comments on a Bilibili video?
faq.a: No. Without a login Bilibili shows guests only a few top and newest threads, so you get a sample of about 60 comments per video including replies. Only text, time and likes are returned; commenter names, user IDs and avatars never are.

faq.q: What are coins and danmaku in the output?
faq.a: Coins (投币) are a Bilibili-specific way viewers reward a video, and danmaku (弹幕) are the comments that scroll over the video while it plays. Both are returned per video alongside views, likes, favorites and shares.
